title: NetworkConnectMcpRequest
description: network.connect-mcp-request@1: one JSON-RPC 2.0 request to Connect's MCP server (POST https://connect.openvibe.network/mcp, or /mcp/all for search and execute over the person's OpenVibe apps). With network.connect.act a first-party service sends it as the person its token names (on_behalf_of), and reaches only what that person granted that service, app by app, on the Apps page. The params follow the MCP specification for the method (tools/list, tools/call with name and arguments, initialize, server/discover).
